page.overview:
Who is Cardiff Baye?

Cardiff Baye was a human Jedi Knight who served in the Grand Army of the Republic during the Clone Wars. Baye held the military rank of Jedi General and led a battalion during a battle on Covenanon. Afterwards, he and his unit were assigned on a mission to Katou. There, Baye dueled with General Grievous and was eventually defeated by the warlord, who took his lightsaber.

Cardiff Baye was proficient in lightsaber combat and telekinesis. He could make acrobatic leaps and control a large creature using the Force.

Cardiff Baye wore armor and wielded a blue lightsaber.
